title: Basics of Biology
eyebrow: Dr. Benjamin Bikman · Peterson Academy · 6 lectures
lede: A ground-floor tour of the cell: what life is, how molecules cross the membrane, what cells are built from, how genes become proteins, how cells divide, and how they turn food into energy.
